architectural_reason: Develop the intersecting inclined occupied wings as a whole-body sectional alternative to box assemblies. The delivered image has continuous rising wings and a connected crossing, but equivalent arms weaken hierarchy and the crossing needs spatial resolution. Compare an unequal junction, opposed rising ends, a broader shared crossing and a recessed approach while inheriting the exact parent dimensions. This is an agent-selected exploration, not a client selection or score promotion; programme, circulation, structure and parking remain to be resolved.
